## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle Wú-period *jātaka* recounting a previous life of the Buddha as the Bodhisattva *Candraprabha* (月明菩薩 — "Moon-Light"; here translated 月明 rather than the later standard 月光). Translated by [支謙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) Zhī Qiān. Signature: 「南吳月支國居士支謙譯」. The narrative is a doublet of *[Yuèguāng púsà jīng (T166)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0018)* translated by [法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2) Fǎxián in the Northern Sòng — the same Indic *Candraprabha-jātaka* in different Chinese recensions across some 750 years.

**Abstract**

T169 is one of Zhī Qiān's documented Wú-period translations, dated to his active period 222–253 CE. The Indic source is the *Candraprabha-rāja-jātaka* tradition; for the doublet relationship with T166 see the entry on that text.
